scope: JETT document workspace UI; PDF engine remains an adapter boundary

events.open: Restore notebook and page; keep other tabs
events.search: Filter notebook names immediately; no mutation
events.sort: Order by name or most recent edit

components.focus: Search retains caret while results update
components.native: Navigation sidebar on desktop/tablet; compact navigation on phone

events.new: Validate name, paper and cover; save then open
events.quick-note: Create with default paper and open
events.import: Native file picker; progress per page; success opens document; failure retains previous workspace
events.restore-backup: Validate whole backup before adding independent copies

components.dismiss: Escape or Cancel leaves content unchanged

events.switch: Keep page and independent undo history
events.close: Keep content; select adjacent tab; stop capture if closing active notebook

events.pen: Commit stroke on release; save status changes pending to saved or failed
events.lasso: Open move/edit/duplicate/delete dialog for selected objects

components.cancel: Pointer cancellation drops only unfinished stroke

events.details: Paper, outline and bounded destination form
events.duplicate: Insert independent page copy after current
events.move: Reorder and follow same page content
events.remove: Remove with Undo; disabled for only page

events.start: Use browser recognizer; native permission belongs to browser
events.unique-match: Navigate and reveal text cursor; PDF text currently lands on page
events.ambiguous: User chooses a match; never guess
events.highlight: Validate current notebook/page; commit reversible highlight
events.dialog-open: Pause recognition before dialog takes ownership
events.drawing: Defer final phrase until pointer release; never replace active stroke

components.privacy: Browser recognition may use its provider's service; no live microphone verification is inferred from mocked tests

components.ownership: Capture source snapshot before asynchronous work; navigation cannot change export target

events.save: Persist preferences independently from notebook content

events.submit: Validate before mutation; close before opening a subsequent surface
events.close: Restore focus to surviving trigger or workspace fallback

events.pending: Do not show a saved receipt
events.leave-pending: Browser close warning protects unsaved work

events.open: Contextual workspace actions; pause voice through shared modal owner
events.guide: Replay four lessons; Back and Next preserve document state
events.action: Close helper before invoking actual creation, voice, export or settings surface

components.motion: 380ms eased shape response; bounded 500ms press ripple; no continuous movement; reduced motion disables both
components.boundary: CSS response, not physical simulation or native Apple material

motion.cursor: Scroll target into view; reduced-motion uses immediate movement
motion.reduced: Disable decorative animation; preserve all state changes

portableAssets.platformAdaptation: Use platform text metrics, permission dialogs, safe areas, accessibility semantics and touch targets while preserving state ownership and outcomes
